timeline.evidenceText: Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still on Gibeon! You, moon, stop in the valley of Aijalon!”
Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.
but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.
Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. The people were very faint;
Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
and Beriah, and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;
Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.

The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland, and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and also Gimzo and its villages; and they lived there.

definitions.short: Ajalon , the name of five places in Palestine
definitions.full: H357. Ayyalon אַיָּלוֺן proper name, of a location ( Deer -field) Aijalon — ׳א Josh 10:12 8 t.; 1 city in Dan Josh 19:42 ; 21:24 (Levitical city) Judg 1:35 ; 1Sam 14:31 doubtless same; so 1Chr 6:54 (where Dan omitted); apparently later in Benjamin 8:13 ; 2Chr 11:10 ; 28:18 (see Be); אַיָּלוֺן עֵמֶק Josh 10:12 almost certainly named from same; = Epiph. Ἰαλω modern Jâlo Rob BR ii. 253 , Survey iii. 19. 2 city in Zebulun Judg 12:12 .
